fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional field indicating the source port of the sending process; zero if unused.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: destination port of the receiving process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: total length of the udp datagram in octets, including this header.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: 16‑bit checksum of the udp pseudo-header, header, and data; zero indicates no checksum generated.

helper functions.name: compute checksum
helper functions.description: computes the 16-bit one's complement checksum over the pseudo-header, udp header, and data, padded to an even number of octets.
